_comment: Sourced base fares, kept in one place so cost estimates are DERIVED from verified numbers rather than guessed per place. The app computes an auto estimate from these; no place entry hardcodes a fare. When these go stale, one file changes.

auto_rickshaw.confidence_note: Minimum daytime fare of Rs 26 is reported by news coverage of an MMRTA revision effective 1 February. The per-km rate above the minimum was not stated in a source I could verify, so it stays null and the app must present auto costs as a minimum-fare floor plus 'metered beyond 1.5 km' rather than a total.

kaali_peeli_taxi.confidence_note: Rs 31 base and Rs 20.66/km reported for the same MMRTA revision. Year of the 'effective 1 February' revision is ambiguous in the source, so treat as an estimate baseline and re-verify. Note the night surcharge ends at 05:00 — a 05:45 arrival at Dadar is just outside it.

suburban_train.confidence_note: Not yet researched. Deliberately null rather than filled with the Rs 10 figure from the brief's own example, which I have not verified for 2026. The brief's quick-add preset for a train ticket must therefore be user-set on first use, not pre-seeded with a number I made up.
